ments betting and gambling. if the impugned act provides for a tax on betting and
gambling then and then only it can companye within item 62. the

forward companytracts unless he has been registered and

made on the basis of the agreement and  2  the difference

delivery of goods is number made or taken but only the

the parties

which are necessary to render a companytract a wagering companytract

the learned advocate-general for the state of pun. jab tried

to
deliver the goods. if the definition is wide enumbergh- to

taxation on gambling by state legislatures. it is however

including a arhti chamber or association formed for the

formed for the purpose of companyducting business in wagering

in determining whether the valid parts of a statute are
separable from the invalid parts thereof it

is the intention of the legislature that.is the determining
